result.reason: The redline appropriately extends the Deliverable conformance warranty to the 90-day fallback and preserves the repair, replacement, re-performance, and refund remedies. However, the supplied operative language does not establish the required professional-and-workmanlike services warranty for at least 30 days, compliance with laws, or absence of malicious code. Those protections cannot be assumed to appear in the unseen Section 19.1. The edits are narrow, preserve the existing remedy structure, and are professionally drafted, but they do not reach the complete fallback position.
